title: Renewing home with room for openness

captions.physics: Changing domestic actions through a realisation
captions.energy: Fixing new understanding through rigid rules

meaning: Your domestic support sustains closeness when new understanding changes actions without requiring both to submit to one correct form of participation.
text: You may want to change domestic arrangements when the value of each other’s presence becomes clearer. Judgement in the physical position of Muladhara appears through actions answering this realisation. The Emperor in energy risks fixing change through rigid rules, while the Lovers in emotions want openness and acceptance. A good aim can become an overly strict arrangement: both decided to meet more often at home, but any departure from the new order supposedly questions readiness to be genuinely present.

For example, you notice evening tasks leave little conversation and introduce time without household work. It soon becomes compulsory to the minute, even when one needs to finish a small task first today. **Closeness is sustained by an agreement leaving room for both people’s actual responses.** Understandable timing helps, but its purpose is an opportunity to meet. Clarifying today’s condition neither cancels an important understanding nor requires the whole shared domestic idea’s value to be proved afresh.

The difficulty is defending new order more strictly precisely when openness is needed. Participation looks correct while personal wishes stay unspoken. Support grows when realisation and rule are not treated as identical. Both can preserve an important aim and discuss form: acceptance needs no complete agreement of circumstances, and clear care allows a manageable correction without an accusation of rejecting closeness.
